description: This file defines classes and methods for managing subscription documents, subscription types, and subscription history in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including creation, copying, and state management of subscriptions.

classes.name: subscription_document
classes.description: Model for subscription documents, including fields for name, active status, linked model, and related fields.

classes.name: subscription_document_fields
classes.description: Model for fields within a subscription document, including field reference, default value, and linkage to parent document.

classes.name: subscription_subscription
classes.description: Main subscription model managing subscription details, process scheduling, copying documents, and state transitions.

classes.name: subscription_subscription_history
classes.description: Model for tracking the history of subscription document generation events.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method for subscription_document to prevent modification of linked model.

methods.name: set_process
methods.description: Creates and schedules a cron job to process the subscription.

methods.name: model_copy
methods.description: Copies a source document based on subscription configuration, updates subscription state.

methods.name: set_done
methods.description: Stops the cron job and marks the subscription as done.

methods.name: set_draft
methods.description: Resets the subscription state to draft.
